deployments_detail.use: Digital-twin and AI predictive maintenance/PHM system for track and bridge health monitoring

SenseTime 'Xingkong' (星空) AI analysis system for 4C catenary (contact-line) inspection: deep-learning image analysis of millions of catenary photos auto-detects and classifies defects across the full line, cutting a routine full-line inspection from 3 years to ~4 days. [SenseTime (商汤) Industrial Engine]
deployments_detail.value: efficiency up 20x; 3M images analyzed by 2 staff in 10 days vs. much longer manually

deployments_detail.use: Fuxing (复兴号) intelligent EMU running on the Beijing-Shanghai line with ATO automatic-driving at 350 km/h — auto departure, auto inter-station running, AI-assisted schedule adjustment and precise auto-stop; upgraded intelligent EMU version entered service June 2024. [CRRC / China Railway (CTCS-3 + ATO)]

BeiDou+5G fully-automatic UAV (drone) intelligent inspection system — China's first — with automated flight planning, multi-drone formation flying, AI defect recognition and risk early-warning for track, bridges, slopes and catenary; first deployed on the Jinan section. [Beijing Jiaotong University (BJTU) + Beijing-Shanghai HSR Co.]
deployments_detail.value: 304 test flights, 3060 min total flight time; millimeter-level precision

deployments_detail.use: Intelligent EMU onboard safety monitoring system (车载安全监测/PHM): sensor + ML-based condition monitoring of bogies — axle temperature, instability, ride-stability, axle-box/gearbox/motor vibration — enabling predictive 'condition-based' maintenance instead of scheduled maintenance. [CRRC / China Academy of Railway Sciences]

Smart Integrated O&M Management System (智能综合运维管理系统 V1.0) combining GIS+BIM, big data and machine learning to unify track/electrical/power (工电供) infrastructure predictive maintenance across the line; passed technical review Aug 2023 and being rolled out full-line. [Beijing-Shanghai HSR Co. + China Academy of Railway Sciences (CARS)]

5G-A x AI network 'high-speed-rail portrait' (高铁画像): China Mobile added a real-time AI inference model in the core-network NWDAF element to identify fast-moving HSR users vs. public users, steering them onto the dedicated HSR network; deployed across the full line (3000+ upgraded base stations). [China Mobile + Huawei (5G-A NWDAF AI)]
deployments_detail.value: >95% user-identification accuracy; typical base station migrates out 60% of public users

deployments_detail.use: Station-level AI services on the intelligent Fuxing line (incl. Beijing-Shanghai): AI virtual smart customer service (AI虚拟智慧客服), face-recognition/no-sense boarding (刷脸进站) and new 3D depth-vision passage detection.

Surrounding-environment safety-hazard intelligent monitoring system (周边环境安全隐患智能监测体系): AI + satellite remote sensing building a 'space-air-ground' integrated hazard prevention/control network along the line, sharing hazard information across stations and depots.

AI high-speed-rail earthquake early-warning algorithm to enhance the Beijing-Shanghai disaster-safety monitoring system's seismic sub-system; the Institute of Engineering Mechanics (China Earthquake Administration) issued a sole-source procurement for testing an AI HSR earthquake early-warning algorithm. [Institute of Engineering Mechanics, China Earthquake Administration]
